name: Terminal
description: System terminal with AI toolchain access

provides.name: terminal
provides.description: MCP over terminal sessions on every terminal instance: list/open/kill sessions, read the screen as a text grid (cursor, alternate-screen mode, scrollback), type text and send keys. Any instance reaches ALL sessions; the stable app-level endpoint /api/proxy/com.aura.terminal/mcp/terminal cold-starts an instance when none is running.

provides.name: sessions
provides.description: Terminal sessions of this instance as REST: GET list (each row has `agent`: what a Claude Code / Codex session reports — running, needs_approval, waiting_input, idle, exited), POST mint an id, DELETE ?id= kill; /screen?id=, /input?id=. Agent events: GET /api/sessions/events (snapshot) or ?stream=1 (SSE `agent` events); hooks POST there. Hook installer: GET/POST/DELETE /api/agent-hooks.

provides.name: embed
provides.description: Embed a live terminal session in your app's iframe: /api/proxy/<instanceId>/?embed=1&session=<id> (no chrome, claims the session). Host posts aura.viewport.changed {contentW, contentH} and forwards theme/keymap/focus; page posts aura.terminal.ready / .locked / .session-ended. Get a session via OPEN_TERMINAL intent with extras.background. Contract: src/embed.ts.
